messages:
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT: High 5xx rate detected for gateway-us-east-1 (avg 4xx/5xx ratio spike). Pager: paging Aisha. metric link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/gateway-us-east-1
Aisha (oncall): saw the alert, I'm on it. starting triage now.
Marco: logs show a surge of upstream 502s from acme-rt backend between 03:12-03:18. sample: `upstream_status=502 host=acme-rt-01`
Keira: is this affecting hosted API keys or only internal traffic?
Marco: looks like both. proxy logs show many client requests were proxied to acme cluster and failed. some large prompt batches in the tail.
Nikhil: I'm checking router config. can we rate-limit or short-circuit to fallback model variant to reduce load?
Aisha (oncall): yes let's enable the gateway short-circuit policy to return 503 fallback with FC-level header for affected routes. Keira, can you prepare the rule?
Keira: on it. patching rule in edge-config: ```json
{
  "match": "/v1/generation",
  "condition": "upstream.failure_rate>0.05",
  "action": "serve_fallback(model: redwood-mini, status: 503, header: X-Redwood-Fallback:true)"
}
```
Keira: pushing now, will take ~30s to propagate to edge nodes.
SRE-Bot: deploy triggered by Keira — change-set 3891 — rollout started.
Aisha (oncall): paging team: set customer-impact to "partial_degradation" and notify CS. @Customer Ops please stand by.
Customer Ops: acknowledged. collecting affected customer IDs from request logs now.
Marco: adding temporary circuit-breaker on acme-rt route to drop >10 concurrent requests per upstream-host. command: `curl -X POST https://edge-config/set -d '{"circuit":true}'`
Nikhil: I applied the cb via the admin API. monitoring for reduction in 5xx.
SRE-Bot: metric update: 5xx rate decreased from 8.7% -> 2.1% in 3m after short-circuit.
Aisha (oncall): good. still seeing some timeouts at the gateway-level. switching some traffic to nyc region as additional fallback. Ravi, can you confirm DNS/routing?
Ravi (eng): started failover to nyc region. traffic steering rule applied.
Keira: edge rollout complete. config ID 3891. Reverting the heaviest batching heuristics for a minute to avoid large upstream payloads.
Marco: after the change, acme-rt shows queued request backlog cleared. seems like batching law was pushing oversized payloads.
Aisha (oncall): summary for now: short-circuit + circuit-breaker + region steer reduced 5xx. Customer impact: partial_degradation for ~18 minutes starting 03:12. No data loss reported.
Customer Ops: CS notified top 12 enterprise customers with brief status and ETA for postmortem.
Keira: opening a quick hotfix PR to add a safety throttle to batch size at the gateway: `max_tokens_per_request: 20000` default -> 8000. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/edge/PR-4821
Nikhil: will roll forward hotfix to staging bar first, then canary, then prod. tagging this incident in the deploy.
Aisha (oncall): action items (quick): 1) Keira to merge hotfix PR and add unit tests for batch size validation. 2) Marco to add detailed logs for upstream payload sizes. 3) Ravi to add a runbook step for region failover with exact commands. 4) Oncall to tune alerts: lower threshold for gateway 5xx ramp and add synthetic check for large batch sizes.
Keira: noted, creating runbook PR now and adding alert tweak in the same change.
Marco: I'll write the log parsers and set an exported metric `upstream_payload_tokens` for alerting.
Ravi (eng): I'll add DNS steering playbook to runbooks/gateway/failover.md and include commands and rollback.
Aisha (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline at 04:10. Nikhil will take over. @pagerduty-bot please transfer oncall to Nikhil.
pagerduty-bot: On-call transfer initiated: from Aisha to Nikhil at 04:10 UTC — acknowledge to accept.
Nikhil: acknowledged, I'm oncall. will follow up with post-incident writeup and timeline.
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT: status -> mitigated. closing alert stream but keeping embargo for 2h for monitoring.
Aisha (oncall): quick retrospective notes: batching heuristics need safer defaults, add preflight check before large upstream forwards, and ensure fallback models are tested for degraded UX.
Nikhil: I'll open the postmortem draft and tag owners. expect first draft within 24h.
Keira: PRs: edge hotfix PR-4821, runbook PR-149, alert tweak PR-732.
Marco: action owner tags: Keira/Marco/Ravi/Nikhil.
Nikhil: closing thread with follow-ups: hotfix merged? pending. runbook PR? pending. alert changes scheduled. will update timeline in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
